headline: Bangladesh cricketers climb ICC rankings after victory over Australia
summary: Players including Shanto and Hasan reach career-best positions in the latest ICC rankings following a Test win.
details: Following a Test victory over Australia, several Bangladesh cricketers have seen a significant rise in their ICC rankings.
Players like Najmul Hossain Shanto and Hasan Mahmud have reached career-best positions in the rankings.
The win has propelled the 'Tigers' forward in the global standings, marking a major milestone for the team.
The latest rankings also saw Australian player Travis Head lose his top position.
caption:
Career-best rankings for the Tigers! 🇧🇩

Following a Test victory over Australia, several Bangladesh cricketers have seen a significant rise in their ICC rankings.

Players like Najmul Hossain Shanto and Hasan Mahmud have reached career-best positions in the rankings.

The win has propelled the 'Tigers' forward in the global standings, marking a major milestone for the team.

The latest rankings also saw Australian player Travis Head lose his top position.

headline_marked: Kolkata hotel fire: [[Journalist and 3 family members killed]]
headline: Kolkata hotel fire: Journalist and 3 family members killed
summary: A journalist from Kushtia and three of his family members died in a devastating hotel fire in Kolkata, leaving behind an 8-year-old daughter.
details: A tragic hotel fire in Kolkata has claimed the lives of four members of a single family, including a journalist from Kushtia, Bangladesh.
The victims include Debashish, a journalist, and three other family members who were staying at the hotel during the incident.
The tragedy has left Debashish's 8-year-old daughter alone in Kushtia, shattering the family's future.
Another victim of the same fire was identified as Ahmed Babu, a businessman from Aminbazar, Dhaka.
The fire broke out suddenly, trapping guests inside the hotel and leading to multiple fatalities before rescue operations could be completed.
caption:
A journalist and three of his family members have been killed in a hotel fire in Kolkata, leaving an 8-year-old girl behind.

A tragic hotel fire in Kolkata has claimed the lives of four members of a single family, including a journalist from Kushtia, Bangladesh.

The victims include Debashish, a journalist, and three other family members who were staying at the hotel during the incident.

The tragedy has left Debashish's 8-year-old daughter alone in Kushtia, shattering the family's future.

Another victim of the same fire was identified as Ahmed Babu, a businessman from Aminbazar, Dhaka.

The fire broke out suddenly, trapping guests inside the hotel and leading to multiple fatalities before rescue operations could be completed.

#Kolkata #HotelFire #Tragedy #Bangladesh #News

Source: Somoy News, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo
